speaker: (narration)
before: You sink into eucalyptus-scented water with an unmistakable base note of gym sock. HP restored; nose unconvinced.
after: You sink into hot water that smells of eucalyptus and, underneath it, unmistakably of gym sock. HP restored, though your nose has its doubts.

speaker: (narration)
before: You're already as rested as a Beefcake ever gets. The tub has done all it can for you.
after: You're already as rested as a Beefcake ever gets, and the tub has done all it can for you.

speaker: Throwers and rippers
before: You land. The ground takes most of the credit.
after: You come down in a heap, and the ground takes most of the credit for the landing.

speaker: Throwers and rippers
before: RRRRRIIIIIP! A portal, torn open by hand.
after: RRRRRIIIIIP! Someone has torn a portal open in the air with nothing but their bare hands.

speaker: Gym attendant
before: Towels are ten gold now, because Clench taxes sweat.
after: Towels are ten gold now, I'm sorry to say, because Clench has started taxing sweat.

speaker: Gym attendant
before: House rule one: re-rack your weights. House rule two: we have no weights.
after: House rule one is still to re-rack your weights, and I do keep saying it, though we haven't had a weight in here for ten years.

speaker: (narration)
before: You grab the bar and heave. Gary slides out, gasping.
after: You grab the bar and heave, and Gary slides out from under it, gasping.

speaker: (narration)
before: "You're a hero! Take this, I borrowed it from the gym."
after: "Oh, thank you, and I'm so sorry about the bother. Please take this - I borrowed it from the gym."

speaker: (narration)
before: "It's not mine, so now it's yours. I think that's how borrowing works."
after: "It isn't mine, so I suppose it's yours now. I think that's how borrowing works."

speaker: (narration)
before: A banana-berry shake. Smooth, sweet, suspiciously good for you. +HP.
after: It's a banana-berry shake, smooth and sweet and suspiciously good for you. +HP.

speaker: (narration)
before: A legendary chocolate-peanut-butter shake. Even your muscles want the recipe. Big recovery!
after: It's the legendary chocolate-peanut-butter shake, and even your muscles want the recipe. Big recovery!

speaker: (narration)
before: Chalky, lumpy... you appear to be drinking an unfinished wall.
after: It's chalky and lumpy, and you appear to be drinking an unfinished wall.

speaker: (narration)
before: The cup has a coin at the bottom. The shake was just a front. +gold.
after: There's a coin at the bottom of the cup, so the shake was only ever a front. +gold.

speaker: (narration)
before: You flex. The mirror flexes back. You both nod. +1 HP.
after: You flex, the mirror flexes back, and the two of you nod at each other. +1 HP.

speaker: (narration)
before: You hit the most-muscular pose. The mirror applauds. +1 HP.
after: You hit the most-muscular pose, and the mirror breaks into applause. +1 HP.

before: LET'S GO! Cards are protein for your deck! Regime-approved! (They are not.)

speaker: Coach Brutus Benchley
before: Floorboard? WHAT floorboard? Do NOT stand on the floorboard! LET'S GO!

speaker: Rip Tearson
before: HNNNGH. Two hundred and twelfth shirt this year. Did you notice my form, buddy?
after: HNNNGH. That's my two hundred and twelfth shirt this year, buddy. Worth every one.
